traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Misdirected effort: setting off one way and ending up another, with energy quietly draining away. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for drive against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the drive/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: It is easy to turn uncertainty into a fight when being angry feels more manageable than admitting you do not actually know what is going on yet. When Mars squares Neptune, urgency can attach itself to assumptions, mixed signals, or an incomplete version of the problem, making action feel justified before you know where the responsibility really belongs. Your instinct that something is wrong may be accurate without your first explanation for it being accurate too. Give the facts enough time to catch up with the feeling before you spend your energy confronting the wrong person or fixing the wrong problem.
